basic_details.job_title: NDTL Research Associate - I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) has announced 3 vacancies for the Research Associate - I post on a contract basis under advertisement number 03 / 2026. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, extendable for another two years. Applicants must possess a Ph.D. in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Biochemistry, Applied Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmacology, or Forensic Science, or alternatively 3 years experience after M.Pharm with an SCI journal paper having an impact factor greater than 1.0. The position carries a consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 58,000

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 60 days from the date of advertisement (02-12-2026)

age_limit.details: Age not more than 35 years. Relaxation up to 3 years is applicable for OBC(NCL) candidates and 5 years for SC/ST category candidates.

qualification.details: Ph.D. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Biochemistry / Applied Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Pharmacology / Forensic Science; | OR | Having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after M. Pharm; | AND | With at least one research paper in Science Citations Indexed (SCI) journal with Impact factor > 1.0;

how_to_apply: Visit the NDTL website Career page at https://ndtlindia.com/career/ to access the online application form link.
Complete the online application form with valid and active mobile numbers and email IDs.
Upload a scanned copy of your photo identity proof (PAN Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Passport) in jpg/jpeg format, ensuring the file size is between 50kb and 1MB.
Preview the application form before final submission to verify all filled details, as changes cannot be made after final submission.
Submit the online application form on or before the last date.

content_sections.heading: NDTL Research Associate - I at a Glance

rows.details: Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable
Not more than 35 years (with relaxations for OBC and SC/ST)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The National Dope Testing Laboratory has advertised a total of 3 positions for Research Associate - I on a contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the prescribed educational qualifications and age limits to apply for the Research Associate - I positions. Ph.D. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Biochemistry / Applied Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Pharmacology / Forensic Science; OR Having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after M. Pharm; AND With at least one research paper in Science Citations Indexed (SCI) journal with Impact factor > 1.0; Age not more than 35 years. Relaxation up to 3 years is applicable for OBC(NCL) candidates and 5 years for SC/ST category candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 58,000/- plus HRA as applicable. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, which is extendable for another two years maximum, or subject to curtailment based on satisfactory performance and conduct. Performance is reviewed yearly, and the contract can be terminated by either side with a notice of one month in advance or one month's salary in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NDTL Research Associate - I
content_sections.text: Visit the NDTL website Career page at https://ndtlindia.com/career/ to access the online application form link. Complete the online application form with valid and active mobile numbers and email IDs. Upload a scanned copy of your photo identity proof (PAN Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Passport) in jpg/jpeg format, ensuring the file size is between 50kb and 1MB. Preview the application form before final submission to verify all filled details, as changes cannot be made after final submission. Submit the online application form on or before the last date.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and mere possession does not entitle candidates to be called for interview. The notification regarding the list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NDTL website, and shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview through email.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Research Associate - I position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, extendable for another two years maximum.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly stipend and allowance for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 58,000/- plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q3. What age relaxations are provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is provided up to 3 years for OBC(NCL) candidates and up to 5 years for SC/ST category candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How will shortlisted candidates be informed about the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via the NDTL website, and details regarding the interview date will be communicated through email.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 60 days from the date of advertisement, which corresponds to 2 December 2026.
